notes.title: Major Update v0.4.0: Missions, Improvements, and More!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce the release of v0.4, packed with new features, improvements, and fixes to enhance your gameplay experience. Here's what's new:

[h2]🆕 New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Missions Added:
[list]
[*] Start with Mission #1 - First Leap:
[list]
[*] Objective: Clear the Ruins domain of all enemies.
[*] Features: Night vision enabled, no revive allowed.
[*] Rewards: Top up to 50,000 points and advance to wave #50.
[/list][/list][/list][list][*] Weapon Type Rotation: Experience more variety with rotating weapon types during the first waves.
[/list]
[h2]🔧 Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] 60fps UI Cap: Ensures smoother performance and responsiveness for the user interface.
[*] Event Dispatcher for HUD: Replaced Interface with Event Dispatcher for cleaner communication.
[*] Item Data Table Optimization: Moved the call to the Game Instance BP Interface for better efficiency.
[*] Weapon Switching Improved: Now handled via an Interface for smoother gameplay.
[*] Enemy Skeletal Mesh: Enemies now spawn without a default material to prevent visual glitches.
[*] Dynamic Material Instances Removed: Guns and fireballs no longer use dynamic materials for performance optimization.
[/list]
[h2]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Edge Jumping: Fixed an issue where enemies would jump near edges unexpectedly.
[*] Enemy Stalling on Jump: Added movement impulse to ensure smoother enemy behavior when jumping.
[*] Pickup While Reloading: You can now pick up items again while reloading!
[*] Wave Aiming Restriction: Aiming is now disabled during wave completion to improve flow.
[/list]
[h2]⚡ Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] UI Enhancements: Removed color binding and introduced Invalidation Boxes for better performance.
[*] Removed Shadows: Shadows on enemy eyes have been removed for a cleaner look.
[*] Body Slot Materials Removed: Simplified material usage for better performance.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the new features, smoother gameplay, and improved mechanics. Your feedback is invaluable, so keep it coming as we refine and expand the game!

[i]Happy gaming,
The Development Team[/i]

notes.title: Game Update 0.3.0: Unleash the Power of Rust Touch!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce the release of [b]Version 0.3.0[/b], a significant update that introduces a brand new gameplay mechanic: [b]Rust Touch![/b] This major update enhances your combat experience and adds a new layer of strategy to your encounters.

[h3]What’s New in 0.3.0?[/h3]
[b]Introducing Rust Touch[/b]
Harness the power of decay with [b]Rust Touch[/b], the first ability introduced in our game! This powerful new mechanic allows you to corrode metallic enemies at close range, transforming them into dust as they freeze in motion. Get up close and personal with foes to unleash this unique ability. Rust Touch not only expands your combat options but also encourages strategic thinking about positioning and timing.

Rust Touch can be activated by pressing the [b]Middle Mouse Button[/b] or [b]X[/b] on your Xbox controller.

[h3]Gameplay Enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Mechanics:[/b] Experience a fresh way to engage with enemies and explore tactical approaches to battles.
[*] [b]Strategic Depth:[/b] Utilize Rust Touch effectively to maximize your effectiveness in combat and adapt your playstyle to different situations.
[*] [b]Visual and Audio Improvements:[/b] Enjoy new effects and sounds that bring the Rust Touch ability to life, immersing you in the experience.
[/list]
[h3]Balancing and Tweaking[/h3]
In this update, we’ve also taken the opportunity to balance existing mechanics and enemy behaviors, ensuring that the introduction of Rust Touch integrates smoothly into the gameplay. Expect a refined experience as we continue to polish and enhance the game.

[h3]Future Focus[/h3]
Moving forward, we plan to concentrate on expanding the ability system, introducing new powers that enhance gameplay depth. We will also continue to add more weapons and maps, ensuring they integrate seamlessly with the evolving abilities, enriching your overall experience.

[h3]Why Version 0.3.0?[/h3]
With the introduction of Rust Touch, the first ability in the game, we felt this update warranted a major version increase. Rust Touch marks a new phase in gameplay, adding depth and strategic options that redefine combat. We’re committed to delivering meaningful content that expands gameplay and enhances the single-player experience.

[h3]Join Us on This Journey![/h3]
As we roll out this major update, we’re excited for you to dive in and explore the new possibilities Rust Touch offers. Thank you for your continued support and feedback as we develop the game further!

[b]Stay tuned for more updates, and happy gaming![/b]

notes.title: v0.2.8 Update: Gravity Gun with Bent Time!

We’ve capped the time speed change at 300%—enough to give you a taste of this phenomenon, but still manageable for an unmodified human.

And this is just a tip of the iceberg of the alien technology we plan to bring to you!

notes.title: 🛠 Incoming Update: Version 0.2.8 – The Gravity Gun! 🛠
notes.notes:
[b]A groundbreaking new weapon is in testing![/b]

Our latest creation, the [b]Gravity Gun[/b], harnesses the forces of gravity itself. Unlike its predecessors, this weapon needs [b]no ammunition[/b] and remains [b]cool under pressure[/b]—a clear advantage over the recently launched laser gun. Yet, its gravity manipulation comes at a cost: it has the potential to bend the very fabric of space-time!

Our engineers are working tirelessly to bring this incredible power safely into your hands, but controlling it has proven… challenging.

[h3]Stay tuned for v0.2.8 to wield the power of the universe with the Gravity Gun![/h3]

notes.title: v0.2.7 Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Revive Mechanic Update: The revive location has changed from a predetermined spot to a random “safe” location. Reviving is an essential part of gameplay, allowing players to continue after being defeated by enemies. The number of revives is unlimited.

[*] Revive Penalty Adjustment: No revive penalty is applied for waves 1 through 5.

[*] Bug Fix: Previously, the revive function did not set the collision capsule correctly. This issue has now been fixed.

[*] Score Update: Negative scores are no longer calculated.

[*] Fireball Damage Adjustment: Fireball damage has been reduced for the first 10 waves to allow for a smoother start.

[*] New Enemy Appearance: Phantom robots now appear starting at Wave 3.

[*] Miscellaneous Fixes: Minor bug fixes have been implemented for issues found in the Achievements (v0.2.5) and Laser Gun (v0.2.6) updates.
[/list]

[*] Headshot Kill: +15

[*] Revive Penalty: -200
[/list]
Let us know how you like the new scoring system.

Thank you for playing and for all your feedback!

notes.title: v0.1.10 Update: The Portal Is Here! 🚀
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce the arrival of The Portal in version v0.1.10! This brand-new feature brings an entirely new layer of control and customization to your gameplay experience.

[h2]What’s New:[/h2]

🔹 [b]The Portal Interface:[/b] Step into the Portal to manage core elements of your game. Within the Portal, you’ll be able to:
[list]
[*] [b]Select Game Modes 🕹️:[/b] Choose between Daylight and Midnight modes.
[*] [b]Choose Maps 🌍:[/b] Once new maps are available, you can select them here.
[*] [b]Adjust Weapon Settings 🔫:[/b] New weapons will unlock customization options in this menu.
[/list]
🔹 [b]Quick Access:[/b] Approach the Portal and press P to open it instantly, giving you seamless access to these controls during gameplay. When switching modes (or maps), the main game variables in the current wave are transferred to the new location—so no need to replay from the start of the wave.

Dive into the Portal and take control of your game like never before! We look forward to your feedback as we continue improving the experience.

Happy gaming! 💥

notes.title: v0.1.9 Update: Checkpoints!
notes.notes:
We're excited to introduce a new checkpoint feature that remembers your highest wave! 🎉

Now, when you start a new session, you can choose to either begin fresh from Wave 1 or jump straight back to your highest wave reached. No more starting over—pick up right where you left off and conquer the next enemy waves!

Happy gaming, and as always, thank you for your continued support! 💥

notes.title: v0.1.8 Update: Enemy Waves & More
notes.notes:
We've got some exciting updates for you!

[olist]
[*] [b]Wave-Based Gameplay:[/b] The game now features an unlimited number of enemy waves. It starts off easy, but each wave becomes more challenging, with faster, tougher robots that deal more damage.

[*] [b]One-Shot Headshots:[/b] You can now take down robots with a single bullet by landing a headshot!

[*] [b]Unified Modes:[/b] We've merged all modes except Midnight into one gameplay experience, featuring familiar robots from Casual, Intense, Ultimate, Marathon, Phantom, and Midnight modes.

[*] [b]New Maps:[/b] Midnight mode is getting its own map with a new landscape, and the unpublished Polar map is also in the works.

[*] [b]Survival Challenge:[/b] We've removed the ammo-to-kill ratio calculation. Now it's all about survival, with unlimited bullets. More weapons and accessories are planned.

[*] [b]Future Updates:[/b] We're planning to add checkpoints or save your highest wave, so you can start from where you left off.
[/olist]

Get ready for the ultimate challenge!
